title: Canyon Run: a multiplayer jet racer in the browser
author: kels0
selftext:
Canyon Run is a low-altitude jet racer: 24 km of canyon, 30 gates, four aircraft, about a minute a run. It's free, with no signup.

Play: [https://canyonrun.kelsoworks.com/?ref=aigamedev](https://canyonrun.kelsoworks.com/?ref=aigamedev)

 How it was made:

 \- Code: Claude Code and Codex, with cheaper models on the routine parts and a stronger one reviewing.   About 230 automated tests kept it from breaking what already worked.

 \- Models: the ships and gates were generated with Tripo3D from my own concept images. Rock textures are CC0 from Poly Haven.

 \- What the tools didn't do: decide what was fun. Play stats showed 70% of runs were abandoned and that people crashed four seconds in, so the opening got reworked.

It's Three.js with no engine, a small Node server, seeded daily courses, ghosts and leaderboards.

I'm not a game dev, but do have some general code experience to go along with my project.
